data.text: Why do you boast of evil, mighty man? The steadfast love of God endures all day.
data.titulo: False Strength before God's Steadfast Love
data.subtitulo: For the music director. A maskil of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech's house.”

data.text: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, working deceit.
You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Selah.
You love every devouring word, deceitful tongue.
But God will tear you down forever; he will seize you and pull you from your tent, uprooting you from the land of the living. Selah.
The righteous will see and fear, and they will laugh at him:
“Look at the man who did not make God his stronghold, but trusted in his great riches and grew strong in his evil desire!”
But I am like a flourishing olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.
data.titulo: A Life Sustained by God's Steadfast Love

data.text: I will thank you forever, for you have done it; I will wait for your name, for it is good, in the presence of your faithful ones.
